cards.title: Bristol Betting Exchange agent-based simulator
cards.reusable_method: Stress-test replay and fill assumptions against a synthetic exchange.
prohibited_claims: Synthetic agents do not prove a real NFL alpha.
Synthetic fills do not validate Polymarket or Kalshi queue position.

cards.title: Order-flow imbalance and short-horizon price impact
cards.reusable_method: Compute price-level OFI and depth-conditioned response only on gap-free prospective L2.
prohibited_claims: Historical trades cannot be converted into OFI.
OFI does not identify exact queue position or maker fill.

cards.title: Polymarket public-book microstructure joined to on-chain fills
cards.reusable_method: Join public order-book events to authoritative OrderFilled records before direction-dependent analysis.
prohibited_claims: The reported 59 percent agreement is not assumed for every NFL market.
Book-feed side or quote inference is not authoritative aggressor direction.
